12. ORDINANCE -2 READING ~ Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of
Cheyenne changing the zoning classification from LI Light Industrial to NR-3
Neighborhood Residential - High Density for land located east of Warren Avenue, south
of 4" Street. (SPONSOR — MR. COOK)

Mr. Segrave moved to approve on 2 reading, seconded by Dr. Rinne. Motion carried with Dr.
Rinne and Mr. Segrave voting “YES” and Mr. Laybourn voting “NO”.

Seth Lloyd, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report. Tom Cobb, City
Engineer, and Brandon Swain, developer, provided additional information. Chairman Mr. Cook
and committee members Mr. Laybourn, Dr. Rinne, and Mr. Segrave commented on the item.

There being no further items for the agenda to come before the Public Services Committee, the
meeting was adjourned at 12:45 p.m.

Submitted by,

Gin thank
